user_instructions: 그냥 새노드 받아서 할거니까 정신차리고 고쳐놔
hypothesis: A fresh verified worker retained every older failed OLMo job and the aggregate task-failure stop, so default launch had no eligible OLMo tasks after the prior controller fix.
attribution: Codex recovery design required a manual retry option after fixing the launch code; repeatedly supplying it as the default command did not meet the user requirement. The prior manual-only policy is superseded by the explicit fresh-node instruction.
fix: Plain joins verify the original node/input binding first, then reopen older-controller failed tasks once per recovery policy. Retain original attempts, checkpoints and RNG/rewards; append recovery_history with controller SHA/policy/worker/previous attempt. Clear only a recognized aggregate task-failure stop with recoverable work. Do not override input/setup failures or held leases. Current-policy failures remain failed; another node or status-only source edit cannot create an automatic retry loop. Explicit retry remains an advanced manual override.

experiment.data: CPU queue/actor fixtures; real production MATH/MBPP metadata DAG seeds5-9;12 fresh CPU worker processes with five held Qwen task leases and all ten initial OLMo jobs failed on the prior controller.
experiment.controls: No retry/new-queue flag on new worker or actor-dispatch argv. Force old OLMo task failures, preserve original binding/checkpoint bytes and failed attempts. Current-controller failures, unknown input error, failed verification, active lease, partially written recovery, current-policy source-only edits are negative controls.
experiment.seeds_updates: Seeds5-9 in metadata fixtures; no H100 model, measured reward or optimizer updates.
experiment.metrics: Before: plain new node exits1 without executing any OLMo fixture task. After: enters fixture execute and retains checkpoint/binding;12-node test claims12 distinct tasks including at least5 prior failed OLMo tasks, one recovery-history record per original OLMo job. These are CPU software claims, not H100 throughput or scientific results.

checkpoint_provenance: Original checkpoint/optimizer/RNG/reward sentinels, source binding bytes and failed exit1 attempts retained. Thirty srgc_rebuttal baseline file SHA256 values unchanged. No result is reset/relabelled; old source snapshots remain archived.
limitations: Actual remote H100 OLMo status/log/stack still unavailable. No claim of real OLMo startup, saved update or measured throughput. No new GPU allocation, paid API/model call, service/listener or public board deployment.
